ruleDefinitions.name: File Download From IP Based URL Via CertOC.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects when a user downloads a file from an IP based URL using CertOC.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\certoc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "CertOC\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX("://[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}.[0-9]{1,3}") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-GetCACAPS.*"))
